neighbours.label: a clause stating a limitation or shortcoming, at the point where the restriction is introduced (restricted to, partly because they, still incomplete)
fire: These surveys are weak, partly because they rely on phone calls.
Membership in the club is restricted to residents of the town.
The drug works only partly, since it is limited to early cases.
Our map of the seafloor is still largely incomplete.
The old model fails partly because it ignores the wind.
Entry to the lab is limited to trained staff with badges.
Their data are thin, mainly because they cover a single year.
The free version is restricted to three projects per user.
quiet: These surveys are popular, and they reach many households.
Membership in the club is open to everyone in the town.
The drug works well, and it helps patients at every stage.
Our map of the seafloor now shows every ridge and canyon.
The new model succeeds and handles the wind easily.
Entry to the lab is free for visitors on weekends.
Their data are rich and cover more than fifty years.
The full version includes unlimited projects for every user.

notes: Card: + pole peaks on ' is' / ' which' / ' they' before limiting predicates; output promotes only/limited/restricted. Probe: 'partly because they' 0.44, 'restricted to' 0.33, 'is still very incomplete' 0.25, 'limited' 0.32; neutral statements 0.00-0.05.
